title: ErrorsNStuff
description: ErrorsNStuff adds intentionally broken and error-themed content to Minecraft, including an edible error item and an experimental error block, designed for testing, experimentation, and playful chaos.
body:
ErrorsNStuff is a lightweight experimental mod that introduces error-themed content into Minecraft: Java Edition.

The mod is focused on intentionally unusual, broken, or placeholder-style mechanics, making it useful for testing, development experimentation, and fun sandbox worlds.

What this mod adds

Edible Error Item
A consumable item that represents a game “error,” created to test custom item behavior, food mechanics, and edge cases.

Error Block (Work in Progress)
An experimental block designed to represent missing or broken content. This block is currently unfinished and may change significantly in future updates.

Why download this mod?

ErrorsNStuff is ideal for:

Developers testing item or block behavior

Players experimenting with strange or unconventional mechanics

Creative or testing worlds that embrace broken or placeholder content

Debugging and mod development environments

Players wanting to eat/make errors

This mod is not intended for balanced survival gameplay and may include unfinished or intentionally unstable features.

Notes

Some content is experimental and subject to change.

Expect placeholder behavior as the mod develops.
